prompt: A single locked-off tripod shot, a quiet seamless living wool miniature at sunset. A few existing firefly lights drift very slowly in small graceful arcs above the meadow, their warm glow gently brightening and dimming at different times. The thin high clouds drift barely perceptibly. All trees, foreground stems, flowers, terrain, horizon, sun and the camera stay firmly still; their wool fibers remain stable rather than shaking or boiling. Preserve the exact composition, shapes, warm pastel light and tactile dry felt. Restrained, peaceful motion for long listening, with steady exposure, no gusts, no waving landscape, no zoom and no new characters. End in the starting arrangement for a smooth loop.
